cohort: The study included 132 pregnancies with first-trimester increased nuchal translucency and cystic hygromas, managed at Corniche Hospital, Abu Dhabi, UAE between January 2015 to December 2018.
finding: Karyotype abnormalities and adverse pregnancy outcomes were associated with increased nuchal translucency, with the highest risks observed in fetuses with cystic hygromas or nuchal translucency >= 6 mm.
